faq.a: Khadiija is associated with the Arabic form خَدِيجَة, whose core sense is khadiija; khadija (somali form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Khadiija?
faq.a: Khadiija is associated with Arabic. Khadiija is the Somali form of Arabic خَدِيجَة (Khadīja), the name of the Prophet's first wife.
Yes — the underlying form خَدِيجَة is Arabic.
Khadiija can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Khadiija should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Khadīja is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Khadiija mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Khadiija is rendered خدیجہ and carries the sense خدیجہ، زوجہ نبی.

faq.q: What does Khadiija mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Khadiija is rendered خدیجه and carries the sense خدیجه، نام همسر پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is kha-dii-ja. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Khadiija?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Khadiija, khadiija. Script forms are خديجه, خدیجه, خدیجہ, خَدِيجَة, ख़दीजा.

faq.q: Is Khadiija a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
